script_text: Stop! Sagittarius, the cosmos is detonating a truth you cannot unsee. Jupiter, your ruling planet of fire, sits in Virgo forming a tense square to Neptune in your 4th House of home, blurring boundaries between reality and fantasy. In love, if single, a sextile from Venus in your 9th House draws a foreign or intellectually magnetic suitor; if taken, avoid vague promises tonight. Career-wise, Mercury retrograde in your 8th House of shared resources warns against signing loans—recheck statements before noon. Blessing: an unexpected cheque or refund arrives via the 2nd House. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
